what: claude-mem by thedotmack gives your coding agent persistent memory: it captures what the agent does in a session, compresses it with AI and injects the relevant context into future sessions. It works with Claude Code, Codex and more, useful when a customer engagement runs across many sessions.

T3 Code by pingdotgg is an "agent harness control surface": mobile, web and desktop apps that control the coding agents on your machine. It works with your existing Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, Google Antigravity and fx setups, so you can check agent runs from your phone while on site.

Worktrunk by max-sixty is a CLI for git worktree management, designed for running AI agents in parallel. Each agent gets its own working directory, so several agents can work on one customer repo without stepping on each other's changes.

ThinkRail from JetBrains is an agentic IDE built around the pi coding agent. It keeps work in separate workspaces and gives the agent durable project knowledge through living specs and reusable skills.

OpenMontage by calesthio turns your AI coding assistant into a video production studio: describe what you want and the agent handles research, scripting, asset generation, editing and final composition. It works with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf and Codex, handy for customer demo videos. AGPL-3.0, check before using it inside a customer product.
